ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Defender Definition Files Removed
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may disable security tools to avoid possible detection of their tools and activities by removing Windows Defender Definition Files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\MpCmdRun\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "MpCmdRun\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-RemoveDefinitions.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-All.*")))
